svg.title: Standard hump: 19 cuts of 1 train
svg.desc: 30 wagons, 152 cuts per hour · misrouted 0 · caught up 0 · impacts too hard 0 · stopped short 0 · gaps 2. Three diagrams: the height of the routes with each cut's energy line, each cut's speed over the distance from the crest, and its distance over time; each cut is a line in the colour of its rolling class.
